Hi Samantha / BrightWave procurement team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the pilot. To finish vendor setup and release the PO we need the following items from your side:

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing General Liability and Cyber coverage (limits in our template).
- An Additional Insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured on the GL policy.
- A completed W-9 (we received a form but the Tax ID there doesn’t match your account record; see note below).
- Vendor onboarding form (bank remit details + invoice routing).

If you can attach the COI and the completed W-9 back to this thread that will speed things up. Also: we require the endorsement language to include waiver of subrogation and primary/non-contributory wording — I attached our short template for the endorsement.

For timing: once we have the COI + endorsement and validated W-9, procurement will issue PO #42015 and routing to finance for payment terms net 30. If you have any constraints on the PO terms please flag them now.

Thanks,

Connor — looped you in for any contract language changes; if we need to add a narrow conditional acceptance clause to the PO (e.g., final COI required within 7 days or PO rescinded), we should do it now.
